text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Question 1: Golshi-chan ran in the Arima 
Kinen with her friend Fenomeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Before that race, what were the words that 
Fenomeno said?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A: "Let's cross the finish line together!" 
B: "Let's cross the finish line together!" 
C: "Let's cross the finish line together!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I never said a single word about that, 
though...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaah♪ No waay, don't get all mad and 
call me a fraud againnn♡

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's running away agai— 
Golshiiii-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Don't go causing trouble for 
Fenomeno at the Arima either! Golshiii!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm tellin' ya! Mame-chin is just 
chasing after me on her own!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Do not make statements contrary to the 
facts!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... Where is she... 
Where's Golshi-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... That's dangerous, sir! Rolling 
around on the turf like that... If I had 
taken even one more step forwardâ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way I'd step on it. It's Mame-chin, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Don't go getting weirdly confident.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha ha! Let it slide, man.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right, Mame-chin? Beyond Japan, beyond the 
whole world. Let's do the most fun thing 
in the entire universe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not older, not younger— our generation is 
definitely gonna be the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ......You again...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I will only say what I am about to say 
once. So keep your ears open."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for everything.
